data.name: Room Mate Collection Giulia, Milan
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodations
Located just steps away from Milan Cathedral, Room Mate Giulia offers modern and stylish rooms and suites with designer furnishings and free WiFi. Each air-conditioned unit boasts a minibar, flat-screen TV, and some even include a private terrace for a touch of luxury.

Convenient Location
Situated a short walk from the Milan Fashion District and a stone's throw from Duomo Metro Stop, guests can easily explore the city and access transportation links to Milan Centrale Train Station and Linate Airport, making travel a breeze.

Wellness Amenities
Guests can unwind after a day of sightseeing at the hotel's fitness centre and sauna, perfect for relaxation and rejuvenation during your stay in the vibrant city of Milan.

Book your stay at Room Mate Giulia for a perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and relaxation.

data.name: Hotel Berna
data.hotelDescription:
Convenient Location near Milan Central Station and Metro

Luxurious Rooms with Modern Amenities

Delicious Continental Breakfast and Dietary Options

Experience the convenience of Hotel Berna's prime location near Milan Central Train Station and Metro. Indulge in luxurious soundproofed rooms equipped with air conditioning, free WiFi, and satellite LCD TV. Enjoy complimentary tea, coffee, and snacks all day, along with free soft drinks in the minibar. Start your day with a delicious continental breakfast buffet featuring fresh fruit and pastries. Special dietary options are also available upon request. Just 4 metro stops away from the iconic Milan Cathedral, Hotel Berna is the perfect choice for both leisure and business travelers. Book now for an unforgettable stay in Milan.

data.name: Grand Visconti Palace
data.hotelDescription:
Luxury Accommodation with Wellness Area
Located just 200 metres from Lodi Metro Stop, Grand Visconti Palace offers luxury accommodation with free WiFi, a refined wellness area with a swimming pool, and a gourmet restaurant overlooking the city’s rooftops.

Elegant Rooms with Gourmet Dining
Each spacious room at the 4-star Visconti Palace features elegant décor, soundproofed walls, a flat-screen TV, and a minibar. The on-site Al V Piano restaurant serves creative dishes of international and Mediterranean cuisine, paired with a selection of Italian and foreign wines.

Relaxing Wellness Facilities and Garden
The wellness area includes a fitness area, indoor pool, sauna, Turkish bath, and a hot tub. Additionally, the hotel is surrounded by a 2500m² garden with deck chairs and sun loungers, offering a peaceful retreat in the heart of Milan.

Book your stay at Grand Visconti Palace for a luxurious and relaxing experience in Milan.

data.name: Hotel Dei Cavalieri Milano Duomo
data.hotelDescription:
Prime Location near Milan's Cathedral
Located just 250 metres from Milan's Cathedral, Hotel Dei Cavalieri Milano Duomo offers a convenient stay in a historic building opposite Missori Metro Station.

Charming Classic Style Rooms
Experience comfort in the elegantly decorated rooms featuring classic wooden furniture, pastel colours, and either carpeted or parquet floors. Each room comes with an LCD TV, satellite channels, and a private bathroom with a bath or shower.

Delicious Dining Options
Indulge in classic Italian cuisine at the hotel's restaurant or enjoy a varied buffet breakfast with cold cuts, cheese, and pastries. For lunch, grab hot snacks at the bar, and savor an à la carte dinner. Don't miss the chance to dine at the top-floor restaurant with a terrace during the summer.

Book now for a memorable stay at Hotel Dei Cavalieri Milano Duomo!

data.name: Urban Hive Milano
data.hotelDescription:
Chic Accommodation in the Heart of Milan

Convenient Location: Situated in the vibrant Brera district, Urban Hive Milano is a short stroll from Milan Cathedral and well-connected to major train stations via Moscova Metro Stop.

Modern Comforts: Enjoy the convenience of air-conditioned rooms equipped with free WiFi, flat-screen TV, and a minibar. The sweet and savoury buffet breakfast will kickstart your day, while the 24-hour reception ensures all your needs are met.

Pet-Friendly: Traveling with pets? No problem! Urban Hive Milano welcomes furry friends with an additional charge, ensuring a comfortable stay for all guests.

Ready to experience the perfect blend of style and convenience at Urban Hive Milano? Book now for an unforgettable stay in Milan!
